resources.string: Keep your finger down after activation. Slide up to increase the value. Slide down to decrease it.

The popup opens first. Keep your finger still for the hold time, then slide. Small initial movement is ignored. Release early to keep the current value. The ready cue follows this swipe’s haptic setting.
Adjustment starts when the popup opens. Further vertical movement changes the value immediately.
An assigned button action runs when the popup opens. The hold time delays only slide adjustment.
Swipe and hold is unavailable while a swipe uses Slide to adjust. Its saved action stays available after you disable that option.
Set the vertical distance for a full change from 0% to 100%. A shorter distance changes the value faster.
Show the full distance beside this handle while editing. Arrows mark endpoints outside the screen. The guide does not change values.
